rules.statement: A right of way acquired by prescription over a servient tenement is not extinguished by the transfer of that tenement, even if the right was not expressly reserved in the transfer agreement.
rules.supporting_quote: "The right existed when Joronis was the owner of the plaintiff's land.. In October, 1911, plaintiffs became the owner of the dominant tenement. The first plaintiff began to use this road in his capacity as part owner of the dominant tenement and as one of the successors in title of Joronis."
